name: Kaisah
tagline: Kaisah helps restaurants and local businesses turn happy customer moments into posted Google reviews
description: Kaisah helps restaurants and local businesses turn happy customer moments into posted Google reviews. Instead of sending people to a blank review box and hoping they follow through, Kaisah gives customers a fast, guided flow with quick prompts, an editable review draft, and a simple path to Google. The result is more review completion, better quality reviews, and less friction for both customers and staff.
